confirm_or_reject_evidence: CLI rejects root selectors and reports canonical-pwd
two cwd-isolated consumers keep distinct payloads
investigation.demand_relation: Remove a redundant public root argument from installed commands.
investigation.potential_impact: Simpler command interfaces without weakening root-bound audit or approvals.
investigation.stop_condition: Reject if commands are allowed to start outside the consumer project root.

statement: When Loki commands start at the consumer project root, resolve consumer state from canonical pwd instead of requesting consumer_root.
